input: Learn to tie five essential sailing knots

gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn how to tie five essential sailing knots, likely for practical use on a boat or in preparation for sailing.

questions.title: Which five specific knots do you want to learn?
questions.description: Identify the exact five sailing knots the user wants to master, such as bowline, cleat hitch, clove hitch, figure-eight, or reef knot.

questions.title: What is your current experience level with knot tying?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is a complete beginner, has tied some basic knots before, or has intermediate sailing knowledge.

questions.title: Why do you need these knots — racing, cruising, or dockside?
questions.description: Understand the sailing context so the most relevant and practical knots can be prioritized.

questions.title: Do you have rope or cord available to practice with?
questions.description: Confirm whether the user has physical materials on hand to practice tying knots, or needs to source them first.

questions.title: By what date do you need to know these knots?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or target date, such as an upcoming sailing trip, course, or certification test.

questions.title: Do you prefer learning from video, diagrams, or in person?
questions.description: Identify the user's preferred learning format to recommend the most suitable resources.

questions.title: How much daily practice time can you realistically commit?
questions.description: Understand how many minutes or hours per day the user can dedicate so a realistic practice schedule can be built.
